qualifying_findings.title: Azure AI Foundry missing authentication enables critical privilege escalation
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: Microsoft's CVE record says Azure AI Foundry has missing authentication for a critical function that allows an unauthenticated network attacker to elevate privileges. The CVSS v3.1 score is 10.0 and the CVE is tagged as an exclusively hosted service with a vendor advisory and patch reference.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window Microsoft-published critical vulnerability and hosted-service patch/advisory for Azure AI Foundry.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry hosted service; missing authentication for critical function.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Azure AI Foundry is used to build and manage generative AI applications and agents; unauthenticated privilege escalation affects the platform control plane for AI workloads.

qualifying_findings.title: LightLLM PD Master registration endpoint lacks authentication
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: VulnCheck's CVE record says LightLLM through 1.2.0 allows unauthenticated attackers to register arbitrary nodes at the PD Master /pd_register WebSocket endpoint. The impact includes disclosure of user prompts routed to the attacker's socket, denial of service by replacing nodes, and induced requests to internal network addresses.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window CVE publication for missing authentication in an LLM serving control-plane endpoint.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: ModelTC LightLLM through 1.2.0; PD Master /pd_register WebSocket endpoint.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: LLM serving infrastructure can leak prompts and route internal requests when worker-registration control planes do not authenticate peers.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad LightLLM runtime/entity context if tracked.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Prompt disclosure, node-registration authentication, DoS, and internal-request risk.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence; CVE publication timestamp is inside the run window.

qualifying_findings.title: vLLM allowed_token_ids validation can corrupt cross-request logits state
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: VulnCheck's CVE record says vLLM before 0.29.0 validates allowed_token_ids against tokenizer length rather than model output logits width. Attackers can submit token IDs that pass validation but exceed the output vocabulary, corrupting GPU logits state and allowing concurrent requests to sample outside their allowlists.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window CVE publication for cross-request model-serving integrity corruption.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: CNA advisory with upstream patch reference
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: vLLM before 0.29.0; SamplingParams allowed_token_ids validation and LogitBiasState.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Cross-request sampling-state corruption weakens output constraints and tenant isolation in shared LLM serving deployments.

upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Model-serving isolation, output-constraint integrity, and shared GPU state boundaries.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High for CVE publication; datePublic predates the run window, so durable synthesis should note that the public technical issue may have existed before CVE publication.
follow_up_actions: Pair with CVE-2026-93841 during ingest if one vLLM sampling-state security leaf is sufficient.

qualifying_findings.title: vLLM prompt token ID handling can corrupt sampler state
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output for CVE-2026-93841 says vLLM through 0.29.0 has memory corruption in the Triton _bincount_kernel because prompt token IDs index the penalty prompt-presence bitset without bounds checking against vocabulary size. Crafted multimodal audio requests can corrupt concurrent requests' sampler state and alter repetition penalty behavior.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window CVE publication for prompt-driven sampler-state corruption in an LLM runtime.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream technical references
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: vLLM through 0.29.0; Triton _bincount_kernel and repetition-penalty sampler state.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Prompt token validation becomes an isolation boundary in shared LLM serving; corruption can affect unrelated concurrent requests.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad vLLM and LLM runtime context.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Prompt-token validation, GPU memory safety, and cross-request isolation.

qualifying_findings.title: CordysCRM exposes MCP form configuration without authentication
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says CordysCRM before 1.7.2 exposes GET /mcp/form/config/{formKey} without authentication because /mcp/** is marked anonymous and the controller lacks a permission annotation. Attackers can retrieve CRM field names, types, required flags, defaults, options, validation rules, and binding sources.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window CVE publication for unauthenticated MCP metadata exposure in an AI-powered CRM.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream patch references
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP endpoints expose application structure to agents and clients; anonymous metadata access helps attackers map high-value CRM data paths.

qualifying_findings.title: CordysCRM anonymous SSE endpoints leak workflow events
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says CordysCRM before 1.7.2 exposes anonymous /sse/subscribe, /sse/broadcast, and /sse/close endpoints and trusts caller-controlled userId rather than deriving identity from an authenticated principal. Attackers can read workflow events, approval requests, mentions, and alerts for another user, inject heartbeat messages, or close channels.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window CVE publication for unauthenticated event-stream access in an AI-powered CRM.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream patch references

qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: AI-enabled CRM workflow streams may carry approval, mention, and workflow context that can be used for social engineering, data discovery, or agent workflow manipulation.

qualifying_findings.title: WPBot subscribers can overwrite Claude AI provider settings
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says WPBot before 8.7.6 lacks a capability check on the AJAX action that saves Claude AI provider settings, allowing subscriber-level users to overwrite settings including the API key used for outgoing AI requests.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window update for an AI provider settings authorization flaw.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: WPBot WordPress plugin before 8.7.6; Claude AI provider settings AJAX action.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: AI provider settings are credential and routing control planes; low-privilege overwrite can redirect model traffic, replace credentials, or disrupt assistant behavior.

qualifying_findings.title: cc-connect card callbacks bypass per-user agent command allowlists
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says cc-connect through 1.5.0 fails to enforce per-user allowlist filtering in the Feishu interactive-card onCardAction handler. Attackers can trigger card actions in admitted chats and dispatch agent commands while bypassing per-user access controls that protect the text-message handler.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window update for chat-card to agent-command authorization bypass.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream issue/code references
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: cc-connect through 1.5.0; Feishu interactive card callbacks.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Shared chat surfaces and card callbacks can become alternate command paths for agents; every interaction path needs equivalent authorization checks.

upstream_routing.ai_dev_wiki: General chat-agent workflow and shared-channel interaction pattern.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Per-user command authorization and alternate callback-path bypass.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: Moderate; publication is before the exact run cutoff by about two hours, but the update timestamp is in-window and the alternate command path is concrete.

qualifying_findings.title: Meta Ads MCP can fall back to operator Meta credentials
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says Meta Ads MCP before 1.0.115 rejects HTTP MCP requests only when both auth_token and pipeboard_token are absent, while not recognizing X-Pipeboard-Token as a primary credential. A streamable-http caller can pass the guard and make tools fall back to the server operator's META_ACCESS_TOKEN, allowing Meta Ads reads or modifications under operator credentials.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window NVD update for MCP credential fallback and operator-token confusion.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream patch references
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: Meta Ads MCP before 1.0.115; streamable-http AuthInjectionMiddleware and operator META_ACCESS_TOKEN fallback.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP servers that bind business accounts to operator credentials must fail closed; token-fallback bugs turn unauthenticated or weakly authenticated tool calls into delegated ad-account authority.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad Meta Ads MCP server entity context.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Operator credential fallback and MCP delegated authority.

qualifying_findings.title: mcp-searxng URL policy bypass enables internal resource reads
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says mcp-searxng before 1.2.0 lets web_url_read URL policy be bypassed while hardening is enabled because redirect targets are not revalidated, 0.0.0.0 is not treated as internal, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 literals are missed. Attacker-influenced tool calls can fetch loopback, internal services, private APIs, service-mesh endpoints, or cloud metadata and return content.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window NVD update for MCP web URL-read SSRF/private-address bypass.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream patch references
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Search and URL-reading MCP servers often process attacker-influenced content; private-address and redirect revalidation failures become agent-readable SSRF paths.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad mcp-searxng MCP server context if tracked.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: MCP URL-read SSRF, redirect validation, and private network controls.

qualifying_findings.title: mcp-gitlab dynamic API URL leaks GitLab private tokens
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: NVD output says @zereight/mcp-gitlab before 2.1.27 reads X-GitLab-API-URL when ENABLE_DYNAMIC_API_URL=true and applies no host allowlist. A caller who reaches the HTTP transport can redirect GitLab API calls to an attacker-controlled host and receive the victim's Private-Token.
qualifying_findings.concrete_security_fact_or_change: In-window NVD update for MCP dynamic endpoint header leading to PAT exfiltration.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: vulnerability database with upstream patch references
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP server dynamic endpoint features must not let tool callers redirect credentialed API traffic; GitLab PAT leakage creates repository and CI supply-chain risk.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad GitLab MCP server context if tracked.
